repos_data.description: MeshRouter: Seamlessly route domain requests to containers across networks using ENS, or custom names, secured by Wireguard VPN.

repo_meta_data.description: macOS menu-bar app for fine-grained VPN routing: bypass the VPN for chosen domains/services, force others through it, or (Custom mode) route each domain/subnet out a specific egress — direct, a specific VPN, an HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy, or a Tailscale peer. Includes a vpnb CLI.
